scenes.summary: 主持人開場預告（保留首圖）
scenes.prompt: Clay podcast studio: hosts Bonbon and Mami warmly introduce today's story about defeating dirty germ monsters and washing hands, small toy green dinosaur car and white spray truck on table, ferris wheel background, playful teaching mood
scenes.refPageHint: Cover page 1 shows green dinosaur car Duoduo washing hands at sink — keep as published cover; hosts are HUMAN clay not cars.

scenes.prompt: Sunny Rainbow Plaza in clay car amusement park, green dinosaur car Duoduo and many small colorful faceless clay vehicles gathered around picnic tables with rice balls, fruit slices and cold juice, festive snack time mood
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: 恐龍車多多 match cover page 1 and portrait — green dinosaur car with orange back plates, friendly eyes. Background cars faceless and smaller.

scenes.prompt: White disinfectant spray truck Penpen arriving at Rainbow Plaza with psssh sound effect lines, large silver spray tank on flatbed, glossy shiny cream-white cab, proud confident smirk, other vehicles turning to look
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: 消毒車噴噴 match portrait exactly — cream-white cab, silver tank with orange hazard stripes, spray mist. Duoduo smaller in background match page 2.

scenes.summary: 噴噴得意吹噓並對桌子噴
scenes.prompt: Penpen spray truck boasting while driving, then spraying fine mist around snack table confidently claiming all germs will run away, Duoduo watching with wide impressed eyes
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: Penpen match portrait spraying toward table. Duoduo match 恐龍車多多 portrait. Each vehicle ONE face only.

scenes.prompt: Duoduo dinosaur car asking eagerly if they can eat snacks now without washing hands, Penpen puffing chest proudly saying of course with me here no dirty monsters to fear, vehicles reaching toward rice balls
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: Duoduo excited eyes match portrait. Penpen proud pose match portrait. Snack table visible.

scenes.prompt: Sudden surprise: gray-black fuzzy germ monster blobs popping out giggling hehehe from Duoduo tire tread, orange excavator Dongdong shovel edge, and red race car Xiao Hong door handle, vehicles jumping shocked
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: Germ monsters match 髒髒小怪獸 portrait — fuzzy gray-black round blobs with mischievous grins, NO wheels. Duoduo, 東東挖土機, 小紅賽車 match portraits. Each vehicle ONE face.

scenes.prompt: Penpen spray truck stunned and denying I just sprayed, germ monsters wriggling and smirking on vehicles, disbelief and comedy tension
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: Penpen shocked expression match portrait. Germ blobs match scene 6 design. Child-safe not scary.

scenes.prompt: Germ monsters taunting playfully, explaining they spread easily and love hiding on touched toys, floors, bathroom door handles and after nose-picking little hands, wriggling proudly
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: Germ monsters match 髒髒小怪獸 portrait in group of 3-5. Mischievous not horror. Show hiding spots as small vignettes around them.

scenes.summary: 噴噴臉紅，玲玲清潔車登場
scenes.prompt: Penpen face blushing red with frustration about alcohol not working, then cream-green street sweeper Lingling arriving gently, calm mentor energy, germ monsters still lurking nearby
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: Penpen embarrassed blush match portrait. 鈴鈴清潔車 match portrait — cream cab green body yellow brushes. Germs smaller in background.

scenes.summary: 玲玲說明酒精與洗手分工
scenes.prompt: Lingling street sweeper gently explaining to Penpen that alcohol disinfects tables and toys well but some germs hide in palms, backs of hands and between fingers and need soap and water, Penpen listening thoughtfully
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: 鈴鈴清潔車 warm teaching pose match portrait. Penpen attentive match portrait. Soft educational mood.

scenes.summary: 大家到洗手台沾濕搓肥皂
scenes.prompt: Vehicles following Lingling to a kid-height clay sink station, Duoduo and Penpen wetting small wheel-hands or brushes under faucet, white soap bubbles forming, Lingling demonstrating scrub motion
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: Match cover page 1 sink scene style — Duoduo at beige sink with soap bubbles. Lingling and Penpen same sink area. Each ONE face.

scenes.prompt: Close cheerful scene at sink: Duoduo scrubbing with lots of soap bubbles counting one-two-three on fingers, Lingling nodding, musical note bubbles suggesting sing-a-song while washing twenty seconds
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: Duoduo match page 11 and cover. Germ monsters panicking in soap bubbles about to wash away. Fun counting mood.

scenes.summary: 小怪獸被沖走，安心吃點心
scenes.prompt: Rushing water swirling germ monsters down drain crying too slippery we cannot hold on, then clean shiny hands and wheels, happy vehicles finally eating rice balls and fruit safely at Rainbow Plaza table
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: Germs washing away in water stream match prior design. Then clean Duoduo eating snacks match page 2 plaza. Triumphant gentle mood.

scenes.prompt: Penpen spray truck lowering head shyly admitting alcohol cannot defeat all hiding germ monsters, soap handwashing is needed for the tricky ones, humble learning moment with Lingling beside
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: Penpen modest downcast eyes match portrait. Lingling supportive smile match portrait.

scenes.prompt: Lingling explaining Penpen can still spray tables door handles and toys while she reminds everyone to wash with soap, Penpen nodding happily, teamwork handshake energy between two vehicles
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: Both match portraits. Penpen happy nod. Cooperation not competition.

scenes.summary: 遊樂園新規則：記得洗手
scenes.prompt: Sunny montage at amusement park signboard showing new rules: wash before eating, after bathroom, after playing toys, after sneezing and wiping nose, Duoduo Penpen and Lingling posing proudly together
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: All three match portraits from prior pages. Rule sign uses simple icons not long text. Warm community mood.

scenes.prompt: Clay podcast studio: Mami and Bonbon teaching children that alcohol helps when no sink but soap and water is most important, count to twenty or sing a song while scrubbing, small sink prop on table
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: Bonbon teal hoodie yellow backpack; Mami pink top coral skirt — match host portraits exactly. HUMAN hosts not cars.

scenes.prompt: Cheerful closing at clay car amusement park: Bonbon and Mami waving goodbye with story friends Duoduo Lingling and Penpen in background, ferris wheel sunset, inviting kids back next time
scenes.refPageHint: PRIMARY: Human hosts center waving match portraits. Story vehicles smaller behind match page 16 designs. Each vehicle ONE face. Warm goodbye.
